This seat is an implementer-side independent closing checker (J162). It is not the item's author. The author lanes are

* Mutants ran one at a time in the seat's own mirror `/home/user/maps-scratch/waves/check-M0-f-03b/plat`: a tar copy of

The checker's ledger row is **L-0705**. The new note is N-14 in `checks/M0-f-03b-notes.md`.
